title: Entity Glide Movement
description: Move control for a flying mob that has a gliding movement

max_turn.title: Max Turn
max_turn.description: The maximum number in degrees the mob can turn per tick.

speed_when_turning.title: Speed when turning
speed_when_turning.description:
Speed that the mob adjusts to when it has to turn quickly.

Sample values:
• phantom: 0.2

start_speed.title: Start Speed
start_speed.description:
Initial speed of the mob when it starts gliding.

Sample values:
• phantom: 0.1
